title: Full height + panel (recommended)
desc: True shape on all 32 rows: 80 × 32 at 4.5° a pixel, 84° N to 60° S, every continent but Antarctica. The 45 columns beside it hold the time, sunrise and sunset (a half sun on the horizon, then the arrow) and day length.
note: Sunrise and sunset are for Chicago on Nov 1 (6:22 AM, 4:46 PM).

title: Sun icons: rays
desc: Three short rays over a smaller half sun, then the arrow. Reads as a sun first, at the cost of a row of height (6 rows).

title: Sun icons: arrow through the dome
desc: One icon, no separate arrow: an open dome on the horizon with the arrow through it, up for sunrise and down for sunset (the usual weather-app symbol).
note: Saves 7 px, but at this size the dome reads less like a sun.

title: Sun icons: rising and sinking
desc: No arrows: at sunrise the whole sun sits on the horizon, at sunset it is half sunk with a dim reflection below.
note: The two differ in shape as well as color.

title: Bigger map, narrow panel
desc: 96 × 32 at 3.75°, 72° N to 48° S: a finer map, and the panel shrinks to 30 columns with arrows instead of words.
note: Loses the same edges as the mild-stretch version: north Greenland, the tips of South America and New Zealand.

title: Whole world, stretched
desc: The same latitudes as the 64 map (84° N to 62° S) over all 32 rows, 2.8 degrees a column: every continent but Antarctica, about 1.6 times wider than true.

title: Mild stretch, 72° N to 48° S
desc: Rows of 3.75°: about a third wider than true. Drops Greenland's north and the tips of South America and New Zealand.

title: True shape, 66° N to 24° S
desc: Square pixels, so nothing is stretched, but only a 90° band fits: most of Australia, southern Africa and southern South America fall off the bottom.
